name: weavster
description: Agentic Build Manifest for the weavster message-oriented integration platform (greenfield re-architecture). Compiled from Phase 2 source-of-truth docs; drives the Prompt 3 build loop.

tech_stack_dna.api_protocol: REST + OpenAPI 3.1 (JSON-first; XML where parity requires)

layout.convention: standard Go project layout (cmd/ + internal/ + pkg/)
layout.rule: all executable entrypoints under cmd/; all private modules under internal/; only intentionally-exported libraries under pkg/. Every internal component depends on a port (Go interface), never another component's concrete type (hexagonal).

acceptance_criteria: Serves the REST API over chi router with OpenAPI 3.1 contract published to agent-docs/openapi.yaml (spec §5).
Enforces CSRF marker-header check returning HTTP 400 when absent (spec §2.13.45, §10).
Emits HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, CSP frame-ancestors 'none', X-Content-Type-Options nosniff; blocks TRACE/TRACK with 405 (spec §10).
Terminates HTTPS with configurable TLS protocols/ciphers and ephemeral-DH sizing (spec §2.13.44, §4.1).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/gateway/...`.
Implements AuthProvider port (local user store) and Authorizer port (resource-category permission set) as interfaces (architecture §3.1).
Supports user CRUD + password change (spec §2.8.26).
Enforces configurable password policy: min length, character-class counts with -1 forbidding, expiration/grace, reuse constraints (spec §2.13.41, §4.4).
Enforces account lockout after N failures for a period with strike decay (spec §2.13.42).
Generic login failure message by default (anti-enumeration on) (spec §2.13.43).
Exposes external auth hook + pluggable MFA hook invoked after primary authN (spec §2.8.28).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/auth/...`.
Implements AuditSink port; local event-store adapter for MVP (architecture §3.1).
Writes protected-content (PHI) access and query events to the audit/event log, excluding sensitive parameters (spec §10).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/audit/...`.
Implements JobQueue port with Postgres FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claiming (SQLite equivalent for local DX) (architecture §3, §9.1).
Triggers polling sources on interval and cron-like schedules (spec §2.4.11-12).
Durable job claim with claimed_by + lease_until heartbeat; startup reconciler re-claims expired leases so a stale node cannot double-claim (gap #4 MVP).
Recovers queued jobs after restart/outage (spec §2.5.16).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/scheduler/...`.
Implements TransformEngine port over wazero; sandboxed guest: no filesystem/network/clock by default (architecture §4.2).

Enforces fuel (CPU), max memory pages, wall-clock deadline, and WASI stdio capture on every instantiation; exceeding a limit aborts with structured error carrying module name + version + input hash + limit type (architecture §4.3, gap #3 MVP).
Registers host functions (parse/serialize, ack, route, store, net, crypto/hash) per-module by declared capabilities (least privilege) (architecture §4.2).
Runs response-transformer and response-selector stages distinct from the initial transform (spec §2.2.7).
Fan-out to all non-excluded destinations; inter-flow routing via route host function (spec §2.3.8-9).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/executor/...`.
Implements Store port with Postgres (durable), SQLite (local), and in-memory (passthrough/buffered) backends; no Postgres required for local DX (architecture §3.1, constraint #3).
Persists received/intermediate/sent message content per configurable storage policy and per-content-type options (spec §2.6.17).
Search by id ranges, date, status, send-attempt count, content subtypes, metadata values, custom metadata columns with pagination/sorting (spec §2.6.18).
Export in raw/processed/transformed/encoded/response/original forms with archive/compress/encrypt; import messages back (spec §2.6.19-20).
Track per-(message,destination) send-attempt count and last error code (spec §2.5.14, §6.3).
Versioned, forward-only migration runner with pre-upgrade backup checkpoint (gap #7).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/state/...`.
Implements Source and Sink ports with MVP adapters: file, http, tcp (MLLP), in-memory, database, smtp, web-service, document (architecture §3.1, spec §8).
Per-destination transmission modes and protocol-specific options (e.g., MLLP framing for TCP sink) (spec §2.3.10).
Message queue (broker) and DICOM adapters are enterprise ports only — interfaces exist, implementations excluded from MVP (architecture §9.2).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/adapters/...`.
Parse/serialize: delimited text, HL7 v2, XML, JSON, X12 EDI, NCPDP, binary/raw; acknowledgment generation where applicable (spec §7).
XXE-safe XML parsing: external entities/DTD disabled by construction (spec §10).
DICOM codec flagged Enterprise if a licensed library is required; explicit coverage matrix documented (gap #12).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/codecs/...`.

Transpiles declarative YAML DSL transforms (map/build/XSLT-style steps, filter, destination-set filter) into Go+TinyGo source, compiled to WASI with a pinned reproducible toolchain (architecture §4.1, spec §2.2.4-5).
YAML is the source of truth; the .wasm is a cached, rebuildable artifact (never hand-edited) (architecture §4.1).
Validates every config artifact against its JSON Schema on load and rejects invalid configs (architecture §6).
Compiles with a pinned TinyGo toolchain; same Go toolchain as the control plane (architecture §10.1).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/compiler/...`.
Content-addressed registry (SHA-256 of .wasm); each module is {name, version, digest, source, signature, created-by} (gap #2).
Lifecycle states draft → promoted → active → superseded → retired; only active modules instantiable; promotion is explicit + audited (gap #2).
Rollback = re-promote a prior version (atomic pointer move, no rebuild) (gap #2).
Verifies module signature before instantiation; signed (Ed25519, cosign-keyless optional) (gap #2).
Garbage-collects retired modules with zero active references; surfaces module ls/history/rollback commands (gap #2).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/registry/...`.
All flows/alerts/snippets/scripts/maps/settings are YAML/JSON under a versioned config root; single source of truth (architecture §6).
config validate / config diff / apply --dry-run produce a plan of changes (added/updated/removed) before mutation (architecture §6, gap #6).
config plan (dry-run diff) + config apply (mutate) with machine-readable JSON plan and --diff output (gap #6).
Drift detection: compare live state vs Git source of truth with an out-of-band changes report (gap #6).
Stores applied plans in the audit log (who/what approved) (gap #6).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/config/...`.
Native Git-backed config store: commit, push, pull (remote-wins), history, working-tree diff, restore (spec §2.10.34, §2.12.39-40).
Historical revisions with content-at-revision and repository log endpoints (spec §2.12.39).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/gitstore/...`.
import legacy command + API endpoint consuming the legacy XML/archive export format (gap #1).

Three-phase ETL: extract (flows/snippets/scripts/users/config map), transform (legacy constructs → YAML DSL; inexpressible scripts → WASI stub flagged for review), load (seed Store then validate against JSON Schemas) (gap #1).
Message history imports metadata + references by default with opt-in --with-content flag (gap #1).
Dry-run report: counts + list of constructs not auto-translated, before any write (gap #1).
Legacy→YAML mapper is versioned and separately tested with its own transform fixtures via `weavster test` (gap #1).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/migrate/...`.
Transactional outbox: receive → persist → transform → persist result → deliver → mark delivered; crash re-enters same job with same message ID (gap #5).
Deterministic idempotency_key from (message_id, destination, attempt) on every external side effect; at-least-once sinks (raw TCP MLLP) documented as such (gap #5).
On ambiguous-result retry, check status first rather than blindly re-send (gap #5).
Bounded retries with backoff, a dead-letter state, and a deadletter admin surface (no silent infinite retry) (gap #5).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/outbox/...`.
Alert definitions triggered by processing errors with configurable triggers, recipients, flow/source scope (spec §2.7.24).
Enable/disable, import/export, and test (fire once) for alerts (spec §2.7.25).
Notifies configured recipients via Notifier when a trigger fires (spec §2.7.25).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/alerts/...`.
Implements Notifier port with SMTP and webhook MVP adapters (architecture §3.1).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/notify/...`.
Implements SecretProvider port; MVP adapters = local credential store + env//run/secrets (architecture §3.1, gap #8).
Cloud KMS/Vault rotation is an enterprise adapter (interface only) (gap #8).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/secrets/...`.
Implements MetricsExporter port: Prometheus gauges/counters + OTel stdout/OTLP exporter (architecture §3.1).
Per-flow statistics (received/filtered/transformed/sent/errored/queued, connector-level) with reset (current/lifetime) and dump-to-file (spec §2.11.36).
Event log with search, count, export (spec §2.11.35).
Time-series statistics for trending + server log viewer (spec §2.11.37).
System status endpoint: id, version, build date, timezone, time, runtime info, charsets, protocols/ciphers, license info (spec §2.11.38).
Structured logs via stdlib log/slog; executor span hooks present for future OTel propagation (gap #3, deferred Enterprise).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/observability/...`.
GET /api/v1/topology returns overview graph (flow nodes + route/dependency edges) per read-only-graph-view-contract.md §3.1.
GET /api/v1/topology/flows/{flowId} returns flow-internal graph (source → transform → destination nodes + message-path edges) per contract §3.2.
Stable entity-derived node/edge ids; no server-side layout; rolling activity snapshot (received/sent/errored/queued/lastMessageAt) (contract §2, §4).
Read-only: no mutation endpoints; requires flows:view permission (contract §5).
Passes `go test -race ./internal/topology/...`.

modules.origin: black-box §3 CLI surface + architecture §7 test command
acceptance_criteria: Composition root wiring all ports/adapters into the single static binary (architecture §3).
Scriptable CLI shell (interactive + batch -s) over the network API with the §3.2 command surface and §3.3 exit-code semantics (spec §3).
Startup flags -a/-u/-p/-s/-v/-c/-h/-d (spec §3.1).
weavster test [--filter NAME] [--format junit|json] [--output DIR] runs flow transforms against fixtures with no Postgres required (architecture §7).
Refuses to run under a privileged OS account unless allowed; terminates non-zero (spec §11).
Cross-compiles to linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/arm64 with zero CGo (architecture §8).
Passes `go test -race ./cmd/weavster/...` and `go build -o bin/weavster ./cmd/weavster`.

glue_modules_note: Modules flagged glue_module=true are gap-driven additions beyond the clean-room functional spec; they were injected from production-viability-gap-analysis.md and are required for production viability: Module Registry (gap #2), Legacy Import ETL (gap #1), Outbox & Idempotency (gap #5). The Scheduler's durable job claim/lease/reconciler (gap #4 MVP floor) and Config-as-Code's plan/apply/drift (gap #6) are gap-driven additions folded into otherwise-spec modules.
